text:
maria: Quick sync — we want a LinkedIn carousel + short X thread to amplify the launch next Tue. Need creative, captions, UTMs, and a routing plan for inbound leads. Who can own assets and who owns routing?

ashley: I can mock the carousel today. can you confirm image specs? 1200x1200 for slides? also want a thumbnail for X.

maria: yup 1200x1200 works. 4 slides max. thumbnail 1600x900. Keep copy tight — one stat per slide.

olivia: I'll write 3 caption variants: product-focus, benchmark-focus, and enterprise-focus. Will drop drafts by EOD.

jonathan: For routing: send form -> webhook -> campaign-bot -> SFDC lead + Intercom conversation. We should tag with utm_campaign=redwood-launch-v1.

ashley: uploaded first mock to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/carousel_v1 (placeholder). thumbnails in /assets/thumbs.

maria: perfect. olivia, can you add CTAs per channel? e.g., LinkedIn CTA: "See benchmarks" w/ short landing. X CTA: "Try the demo" w/ smart link.

olivia: yes. Drafts:
- LinkedIn (benchmark): "How we cut avg latency 2.3x for real apps — deep dive + benchmarks. See results -> [link]"
- LinkedIn (product): "Faster inference for devs — launch today. Try a free endpoint -> [link]"
- X thread opener: "We just launched a faster way to run large models in production. TL;DR: lower latency, better cost. 1/6"

ashley: small ask — can we get the benchmark chart data? need CSV to make slide 2.

sachin: i have the cleaned CSV, uploading to the drive: /data/launch_bench_v1.csv. note: metrics are avg p95 latency across 1k samples.

maria: awesome. routing details: jonathan, can you paste the webhook spec and sample payload? want to confirm Intercom mapping.

jonathan: webhook payload example:
```
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "name": "{{name}}",
  "source": "social_launch",
  "utm_campaign": "redwood-launch-v1",
  "interested_product": "redwood-api"
}
```
We map email -> Contact, create Lead record in SFDC with campaign=redwood-launch-v1, and post note in Intercom with source + link to landing.

maria: perfect. olivia — please include a hidden field in the LP for utm_campaign=redwood-launch-v1 so we can test.

olivia: done in draft. also added a checkbox for "I want a demo" to prioritize routing.

maria: scheduling windows: for LinkedIn, Tue 10:00 PT and Wed 16:00 PT (boost). For X thread, Tue 09:30 PT and retweet 2h later from company handle. everyone good?

ashley: good for assets. delivering final PNGs by 10:30 PT tomorrow.

sachin: i can QA link tracking after assets go live. will run a smoke test and report.

campaign-bot: Reminder set — schedule posts on 2026-09-14 09:30PT for X thread and 10:00PT for LinkedIn carousel.

maria: last bit — engagement follow-up plan: olivia, draft 2 nurture email templates (high intent, low intent) and add to cadence. sachin, set zap to flag leads with demo checkbox as high-intent and route to AE queue.

olivia: noted. will drop templates in /campaigns/launch/email_templates by EOD tomorrow.

jonathan: i've created SFDC campaign "redwood-launch-v1" and added initial members (test leads). Please don't add production leads until we confirm mapping.

maria: great. thanks team — checkins tomorrow 10:00 PT. Any blockers?

ashley: none.

sachin: none.

olivia: none.

maria: ok locking this thread. Final deliverables checklist:
- carousel PNGs (ashley)
- captions A/B (olivia)
- webhook + SFDC mapping tested (jonathan + sachin)
- UTM tracked LP (olivia)
- nurture templates (olivia)
- post schedule (campaign-bot)

maria: :rocket:
